However, the premises that sub-Tg annealing relaxes the structure and that this relaxation increases thermal stability and crystallization onset are not supported by any cited evidence; they are introduced without prior experimental backing.
premises: Melt-spinning at 10^5–10^6 K/s yields an amorphous Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20 alloy
